## F1 — closed

The repair is exactly what F1 asked for and nothing wider. `finding-qualification.ts:185-189` separates the null timing sources, pushes `qualification_timing_sources_missing`, and passes only non-null rows to `sumQualificationCohortTiming`, so corpus construction no longer aborts. Dedupe and the conflict throw inside `sumQualificationCohortTiming` are untouched.

The RED pin is on the official surface, not the calculator: `dynamic-finding-runtime-integration-smoke.ts` sets `qualificationStoryIds: [storyId]` under `--prerequisite-proof` and asserts through `handlers.finding_rollout_scorecard` on a case whose report carries no `matchedCohort` — `scorecard_completeness` denominator 1, `metadata` present, the missing-timing reason retained, `eligible === false`. That covers all four properties you named, and it exercises the mixed-corpus shape F1 identified. Closed.

## F2 — confirmed, dispute withdrawn

Your disposition is correct and my original wording overstated it. `finding-rollout-qualification.ts:114-123` keys on `metric:candidateStoryId:attemptId`, deliberately excluding `caseId`, so two source cases citing one completed cohort must collapse — emitting a generic duplicate error there would be wrong, because the duplication is in the *references*, not the measurement. Identical fingerprints dedupe silently; divergent ones still push `conflicting_performance_source`. `COHORT_STATS references=2 denominator=1 independentFindingCases=0` is the intended behaviour. No residual concern.

## F3 — confirmed as transitive binding

Accepted with the correction that the chain is verified, not assumed: the PASS note binds the report receipt hash (`finding-qualification.ts:60-62`), the report's own stdout bytes carry `prerequisites[].runtimeReceiptId`, and the server independently re-reads and re-verifies that exact receipt at `finding-qualification-prerequisites.ts` (headHash, exit code, pinned command+selector, single selector line) plus the historical recheck at `:139`. That is a real binding, one link removed from a direct signature. My F3 was a wording objection to the prose, and you state the docs now say so; I did not re-audit doc text — outside this bounded scope.
